# IP → country database

`dbip-country-lite.mmdb` is the free **DB-IP IP to Country Lite** database,
licensed **CC BY 4.0** — attribution: this product includes IP2Location LITE-style
data available from <https://db-ip.com>. Downloaded from
`https://download.db-ip.com/free/dbip-country-lite-YYYY-MM.mmdb.gz`.

Used only for coarse country-level language inference on first visit
(`GET /geo/client-language`). Refresh occasionally (monthly releases) —
country-level allocations drift slowly, so staleness is low-risk.
